[[File:Teleport crystal detail.png|left|100px]]
A '''teleport crystal''' is a small [[crystal]] which can teleport a player to the elven village of [[Lletya]] (and [[Prifddinas]] upon completion of the [[Song of the Elves]] quest). Both teleports are reasonably close to a [[bank]], and the [[Lletya]] teleport is close to a [[fruit tree patch]] and an [[altar]].

The crystal has four teleport charges when initially received and, when used up, becomes a [[crystal teleport seed]]. It can then be recharged by [[Eluned]] for 150–750 coins; she will recharge the crystal for the player when it's out of charges; upon completing the [[Western Provinces Diary#Hard|Hard Western Provinces Diary]], she can enchant 5 instead of 3 charges. Players may possess multiple teleport crystals at the same time. After the completion of the Song of the Elves quest, crystals can be charged by [[Eluned]] in south-west Prifddinas or by the [[Elven Scout|elven scout]] at Eluned's former locations. You can find her location in [[Eluned#Finding Eluned]]

Crystal teleport seeds can be obtained as a common drop from [[Elf warrior]]s and [[Elf guard]]s. Note that these are only dropped by the elves found in [[Lletya]] and [[Prifddinas]], as the elves in the [[Iorwerth Camp]] will '''not''' drop it. Players are also required to at least have started [[Mourning's End Part I]], though 50 [[Thieving]] is not required to obtain it. Elf warriors may drop it with one charge or no charges at all.

After [[Song of the Elves]], players can craft an [[eternal teleport crystal]] to allow unlimited teleports. Eternal teleport crystals are crafted from the rarer [[enhanced crystal teleport seed]] rather than the common [[Crystal teleport seed|crystal teleport seeds]].
